title: Olympic Class
content: My speciality. I offer coaching for the 4.7, Radial and Standard rigs for all levels and abilities. Small or large, I can help you reach goals with smart training and efficient coaching maximising your development on and off of the water.

title: Flying Lessons
content: This new class of boat opens up the thrill of foiling to a huge amount of different people. I am now the UK WASZP Class Chairman and a regular on the race circuit.

title: RS Aero
content: I am the past RS Aero 7 National and World champion. Just like the Laser, I offer elite coaching to any Aero sailors who want to sharpen up to become faster and smarter sailors.
